appsEmptyHint: Try another name or refresh the list.

historyKeep: History entries to keep per feature

runtimeRestoreError: Could not restore the previous local model. Stop local work and reload the model.
updatesHint: Download the native installer, then quit Viezan before installing. Your current app and data remain unchanged during download. On Linux, the package folder opens so you can replace your AppImage and retain the previous one.

updateSignatureError: The Windows installer signature could not be verified.
deleteInterpretation: Delete this interpretation and its analyses?
fanCalibrationHint: Calibration briefly runs each fan at maximum between automatic baselines. It takes several minutes. Stop, stale sensor data or a helper restore cancels control.
startupError: Could not update login settings. Check system approval.
microphonePermissionHintWindows: Viezan needs microphone access to listen. Allow desktop apps to access the microphone in system Settings, then click Check again.
restorePreferences: Restore language, appearance, voice, runtime and pricing preferences
usageHint: Provider-reported text tokens only. Missing usage is unknown, not free. Estimates use your rates and exclude search, images, audio, cache pricing and taxes. Deleting history removes its counters.
usageRate: Price per million tokens for the selected model
usageInvalid: Enter nonnegative finite rates and a three-letter currency code.
systemAudioError: System audio capture could not start or was interrupted. Check screen and audio recording permission.
voiceHint: Leave the voice blank for the provider default. Cloud voices send the selected text to that provider.
deletePermanentlyConfirm: Permanently delete this archived session? This cannot be undone.
dataOperationError: The data change could not be saved.
compareModelHint: Filter models, pick two or three to compare
runtimeExternal: An existing Ollama service is running. Viezan will use it without changing or stopping it.
runtimeMissing: Install Ollama before starting its local runtime.
runtimeStartError: The local runtime did not start or exited unexpectedly.
runtimeHint: These limits apply to the Ollama process started by Viezan. Existing services keep their settings. Stopping the runtime interrupts its active requests.
appProtected: Protected item; use the application or system settings to manage it.
appIncomplete: The scan could not read every location. This is not a complete cleanup plan.

appReset: Reset the selected data and keep the app
noLocalModels: No models on this Mac yet.
appQuit: Allow the application to quit normally
appConfirm: Move the selected files to Trash?

appNativePlatformHint: Uninstall and data reset are available in the macOS app. On Windows, manage installed applications through system settings.
menuBarVisible: Show Viezan in the menu bar

menuBarTemperature: Show temperature in the menu bar

sourceTooLong: Longer than 5,000 characters; split the text.
attachFailed: The image could not be attached. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF under 20 MB only.
updateLatestVersion: You are on the latest version (v{version}).
autoCheckUpdatesDescription: Checks when Viezan opens and once a day; asks only when a new version exists. Manual checks still work when off.
voicePreviewText: This is the Viezan reading voice. Have a productive day.
voiceKeysHint: OpenAI, Gemini, Groq and ElevenLabs keys live under AI providers.
resetNotice: A fresh turn was opened after the break.
exportFailed: The file could not be exported.
interpretStorageError: Cannot read or save interpretation history. Existing data has been preserved.
interpretQueueFull: Audio capture stopped because the processing queue or session limit was reached. Pending segments are still processing.
interpretSummaryLimit: This transcript is too large to summarize in a single request.
fanHelperDescription: Manual control requires the signed native fan helper and system approval. The helper restores automatic control on disconnect, timeout or overheating.
thermalReaderMissing: The bundled SMC reader is missing.
thermalReadError: No readable sensors or sensor read failed.
fanControlError: Fan control failed or the helper is unavailable.
thermalPlatformHint: Linux reads available hwmon sensors without changing fan control. Windows requires a supported sensor backend; the macOS app uses the SMC helper.
shortcutError: Cannot register or save this shortcut. Choose a different combination.
shortcutPlatformHint: Global shortcuts use native registration on macOS/Windows and the desktop portal on Linux. Conflicts or missing portal support are reported.
selectionPermissionHint: Selection access on macOS requires Accessibility permission. Replacement checks the original selection again.
selectionUnavailable: Cannot read selected text. Check permissions or paste the text manually.
selectionChanged: The original selection changed or cannot be edited. Copy the result instead.
quickSecondaryOff: Off — always translate into the primary language
quickSecondaryHint: Only for quick translate; the Translate page is not affected
quickPairOn: Text in the primary language goes to the secondary one; anything else goes to the primary language
quickPairOff: All text is translated into the primary language
quickModelHint: Uses the model selected in the app
quickNeedsAccessibility: Allow Viezan under Accessibility in System Settings.
quickReadOnly: This text can't be replaced here. Copy the translation instead.
selectionCopyHint: Copy the translation to paste it into the original application.
captureError: Screen capture is unavailable or permission was denied.
ocrProviderHint: OCR sends the image to the selected model:
ocrModelRequired: Select a vision-capable provider model to extract text.
backupDescription: Back up sessions, research progress, prompts, interpretation and images. Import adds missing IDs without overwriting existing sessions. API keys are excluded. Legacy exports must first be converted with the offline migration tool.
backupError: The backup is invalid, too large, has conflicting attachments, or could not be saved.
localModelsHint: Manage models in the running Ollama service on this computer. Downloads can be large.
imageError: The image could not be read. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP under 20 MB.
draftChanged: The draft changed. The extracted text is available to insert.
audioError: Audio processing failed. Check the device and provider.
keyStorageError: The OS credential store is unavailable.
keyStorageHint: Keys stay in the OS credential store. Linux requires Secret Service and secret-tool.
providerMissingKey: No API key. Add one in Settings.
providerAuthError: The API key is invalid or lacks permission.
providerRateLimit: Provider rate limit reached. Retry later.
providerInvalidResponse: The response is invalid or interrupted.
providerTruncated: The response is incomplete. Adjust the request and retry.
dictionaryTermLimit: Use at most 120 characters for the term.
generalDescription: Language and keeping work on this device.
appearanceDescription: Display mode and content text size.
readingSizeDescription: Applies to conversations, translations, drafts and previews. Controls keep their system size.
changesImmediately: Changes apply immediately and are saved on this device.
recoveryDescription: Drafts and results are kept when switching features or reopening the app. Interrupted tasks run again only when you choose Retry.
previewScopeDescription: Chat, translation, dictionary, interpretation, speech, images, research, launcher and system tools run in Swift or C++ with native platform integration.
emptyChat: What would you like to work on?
instructionsHint: For example: answer briefly, in Vietnamese, with an example.
deleteUndoHint: Delete this session. Undo for a few seconds.
searchModels: Search models or type an ID
emptyHint: Ask, write or research. Your work stays on this device.
storageError: Changes could not be saved. Your draft remains in memory.
storageLoadError: Saved data could not be read. The original file is preserved; automatic saving is paused.
providerError: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and model, then retry.
recovered: Content was recovered. Interrupted tasks need to be restarted explicitly.
settingsInfo: Data stays in the native application folder. Provider credentials use the OS credential store and are excluded from backups. Import converted legacy exports through Data settings.
thermal_subtitle: Temperatures, fan speeds and CPU load, read every two seconds while this page is open.
thermal_unsupported_desc: Viezan reads sensors on macOS through its bundled SMC reader and on Linux through hwmon. Windows is not supported yet.
thermal_reader_missing_desc: The viezan-smc helper was not found next to the app. In a development checkout, run npm run build:native and reopen this page.
thermal_error_desc: Viezan could not read the sensors just now. Try again in a moment.
thermal_no_sensors_desc: This machine reports no temperature sensors that Viezan can read, so there is nothing to show here.
thermal_tray_enable_desc_menu_bar: The temperature stays in the menu bar and keeps updating every five seconds while this window is hidden.
thermal_tray_enable_desc_tray: The temperature appears in the tray icon tooltip and keeps updating every five seconds while this window is hidden.
thermal_tray_error: The menu bar option could not be saved.
thermal_fan_control_desc: Hold each fan at a fixed speed through Viezan's privileged helper. Automatic control returns by itself when the app quits, the helper loses contact, the Mac sleeps or wakes, or a sensor gets too hot.
thermal_fan_helper_unsupported: Fan control is available on macOS only.
thermal_fan_helper_missing: The viezan-fan-helper binary was not found next to the app. In a development checkout, run npm run build:native.
thermal_fan_helper_idle_desc: Turning it on asks for an administrator password and starts the helper for this session only.
thermal_fan_helper_error_title: The helper could not be started
thermal_fan_sensor_missing: This sensor is not in the current reading; the fan keeps its last target.
thermal_fan_source_dialog_desc: Every raw sensor this machine reports. The fan will follow this one sensor only.
thermal_options_desc_fans: Fan sensor detection and the reading outside this window.
thermal_fan_calibrate_desc: Runs each fan at full speed for a short while and notes which sensors cool down, so every fan can follow the sensors next to it.
thermal_fan_calibrate_cancelled: Detection stopped; fans are back on automatic control.
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_title: Detect which sensors each fan cools
thermal_fan_profiles_desc: One setting for every fan, for a situation. Changing a fan by hand switches back to custom.
thermal_fan_profiles_need_helper: Turn on fan control to apply a profile.
thermal_fan_profile_error: The profile could not be applied.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_quiet_desc: Fans stay at their minimum until the CPU passes 70°C.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_cool_desc: Fans ramp from 45°C and reach full speed at 75°C on the CPU.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_gaming_desc: Fans follow the GPU: ramp from 50°C, full speed at 80°C.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_local_ai_des: Aggressive cooling for long model runs: ramp from 45°C, full speed at 70°C on the CPU.
thermal_fan_restored_reason: The helper returned the fans to automatic control ({reason}).
thermal_fan_disclaimer_intro_daemon: Viezan will install a small background helper with administrator rights. Your system asks for your password this once; after that Viezan reconnects by itself every time it opens, including after an update.
thermal_fan_helper_installed_desc: Installed. Viezan uses it without asking for your password again and puts your fan setting back after the app reopens or the Mac wakes.
thermal_fan_helper_not_installed_desc: Not installed. Turning fan control on for the first time installs it (one password prompt).
thermal_fan_helper_outdated_desc: This version of Viezan comes with a new helper. Update to use it; macOS asks for your password once.
thermal_fan_helper_approval_desc: macOS needs you to allow Viezan to run in the background in System Settings. Then turn fan control on again.
thermal_fan_disclaimer_intro: Viezan will start a small helper with administrator rights for this session. Your system will ask for your password.
thermal_fan_disclaimer_point_range: It only sets speeds within the range your machine reports
thermal_fan_disclaimer_point_restore: Every fan goes back to automatic when the app quits, the connection drops, or the machine sleeps or wakes
thermal_fan_disclaimer_point_ceiling: Fans also go back to automatic when a sensor crosses {ceiling}°C
thermal_fan_disclaimer_warning: Running fans slower than the system would can raise temperatures and shorten hardware life. You use this at your own risk.
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_intro: Viezan runs each fan at full speed for about a minute and compares temperatures, so each fan follows the sensors next to it.
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_point_time: It takes a few minutes and gets loud
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_point_spee: It only ever speeds fans up, never slows them down
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_point_setu: Keep the machine on a flat surface and avoid heavy work meanwhile
launcher_hotkey_system_conflict_toast: {owner} is using the Launcher shortcut {hotkey}, so Viezan cannot open with it.
launcher_spotlight_prompt_desc: macOS currently opens Spotlight with Command+Space. If you agree, Viezan turns the Spotlight shortcut off in your macOS keyboard settings and opens Viezan Launcher with Command+Space instead.
launcher_spotlight_prompt_note: You can turn the Spotlight shortcut back on at any time on the Launcher & shortcuts page. If you keep Spotlight, the Launcher uses Option+Space.
launcher_spotlight_replaced: Spotlight shortcut turned off. Viezan Launcher now opens with Command+Space.
launcher_spotlight_relogin: The Spotlight shortcut is turned off in your settings, but macOS applies it after you log out and back in.
launcher_spotlight_replace_failed: Could not turn the Spotlight shortcut off. Turn it off manually under System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Spotlight.
ai_chat_popup_empty_desc: Type a focused question or paste context from the current task.
ai_chat_popup_input_too_long: Input is too long. Trim it down to send.
launcher_placeholder: Search apps, translate, look up, or ask AI…
launcher_apps_unavailable: Applications are unavailable. AI and web search are still available.
launcher_open_failed: Could not open this item. Try again.
launcher_hotkey_failed: Could not register this shortcut. Choose another combination.
launcher_currency_unavailable: Exchange rates are unavailable offline. Connect to the internet and try again.

dictionaryNotFoundNone: There is no entry for this form in {language}.
imageKeyNotice: Creating images needs an OpenAI or Gemini API key.
clearHistoryDetail: Deletes all Chat, Translate, Dictionary and Interpret history, including saved and archived items.
clearHistoryConfirm: Delete {count} history items? This can't be undone; export a backup first.
microphonePermissionHint: Viezan needs microphone access to listen. System audio also needs screen recording access. When granted, choose Check again.
historyRenameHint: The name appears in History, Home and the breadcrumb. Leave it blank to use the first question.
historyNoMatchesHint: Try another search or turn off the Archive filter.
